## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/_mcp_models.py` (558 LOC, 33 public models) hand-mirrors `src/rebar/schemas/*.json`, policed by `src/rebar/schemas/check_mcp_models.py` and two drift test modules; bug lowly-lawrencium-ovenbird still found 41 drifted properties and wire nulls. The MCP SDK validates every structured result against the advertised `outputSchema` (`jsonschema.validate` against `tool.outputSchema`, `mcp/server/lowlevel/server.py:566-575`, mcp 1.29.0), so the mirror is a second contract that can only be wrong. Decision: advertise the canonical files, return the library payload unchanged, delete the mirror. Cites: origin/main 4eee1de6b66.

## Approach
New `src/rebar/_mcp_schema.py` (about 220 LOC): `OUTPUT_SCHEMAS_BY_TOOL` maps tool -> (schema names, kind). `object` = the one canonical object schema; `array` = the canonical array schema under `{"result": …}` (`get_file_impact`, `get_verify_commands`, `summary`); `list_of` = `{"result": [S]}` (S one schema, or `anyOf` of two): `list_tickets`, `recent_session_logs` (`ticket_state`), `search` (`search_result`), `ready_tickets` (`ready_ticket_summary`, `ticket_state`: lean rows by default, full rows with `full=true`). `inline_schema(names, kind)` hoists `common.schema.json#/$defs/*` into local `$defs` and drops `$schema`/`$id` (transitively; `jsonschema.validate` cannot resolve cross-file refs). `install_canonical_output_schemas(mcp)` rebinds `mcp.tool` like `install_error_guard` and, after registration, sets `mcp._tool_manager.get_tool(name).fn_metadata.output_schema`, asserting `output_model is not None` and `wrap_output == (kind != "object")` (a mis-declared kind fails at startup). `tool_annotation_presets()` moves here verbatim. Install it in `mcp_server.py` after `install_js_safe_guard` (`:608-609`).
Tool bodies return the library dict or list unchanged, annotated `-> dict[str, Any]` / `-> list[dict[str, Any]]` (prototyped). `_ack`/`_with_push` (`_mcp_writes.py:85-110`) build dicts and omit `None`-valued keys; `show_ticket` adds `plan_review_health`/`cross_session_warning` only when computed; `set_file_impact`/`set_verify_commands` take `list[FileImpactEntry]` / `list[VerifyCommandEntry]` from `rebar.types`, which removes `ctx.dump`/`_dump` (`mcp_server.py:413-419,598`). `transition_ticket`/`reopen_ticket` gain `transition_result`; the other 11 schema-less tools stay so (LLM ops return `_structured_llm_failure` dicts a validator would reject). Null-vs-absent: a key the library omits is absent, never null.
Schemas: add `common.$defs.push_status` (`state` enum ok|pending|unknown required; `reason`/`detail`/`remote_ref`/`unpushed` string, `since` number) `$ref`'d from claim/create/sign/transition results, and optional `cross_session_warning` string on `ticket_state`, `gate_result`, `transition_result`. New: `write_ack` (`result` required; `push_status`, `description_warning`, `cross_session_warning` optional), `attach_commits_result` (`ticket_id`, `attached`), `gate_run` (`job_id`, `status`; nullable `ticket_id`/`gate_type`; optional `verdict`/`error`/`durable`/`findings`), `verify_completion_status` (`ok`, `verdict`, `reason`; nullable `verified_at_sha`, `signed_at`). Regenerate `types.py` (`gen_types`); wire the new files into `OUTPUT_SCHEMAS` (keys `attach_commits`, `gate_status`, `verify_completion_status`, `write_ack`). Also delete the `MCP_ENV_VARS` `deprecated` key and suffix (`mcp_server.py:684`), `uvicorn_graceful_seconds` (`_mcp_serving.py:103,121,137-138`) and `DEFAULT_UVICORN_GRACEFUL_SECONDS` (`_mcp_health.py:51-52`). Update `_mcp_budget._wire_bytes`, `gen_mcp_reference.py:96,205-212`; regenerate `docs/mcp-reference.md`.

## Scope
Delete: `src/rebar/_mcp_models.py`, `src/rebar/schemas/check_mcp_models.py`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_model_schema_drift_{happy,heldout}.py`, the CI step `MCP model schema drift gate` (`_build-and-test.yml:844-857`), which main now wraps in the ee2a if-present guard (4eee1de6b66), so Gerrit running main's workflow on this tree skips it. The inert `pyproject.toml:583` ruff ignore STAYS (editing `pyproject.toml` trips the pip-audit lane on open advisories; task astrakhan-sylphish-imago removes it). New: `src/rebar/_mcp_schema.py`, four schema files, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_output_schema_canonical.py`. Edit: `mcp_server.py`, `_mcp_reads.py`, `_mcp_writes.py`, `_mcp_llm.py:16`, `_mcp_budget.py`, `_mcp_serving.py`, `_mcp_health.py`, `schemas/__init__.py`, `schemas/common.schema.json`, six existing schema files, `types.py` (generated), `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py`, `docs/mcp-reference.md` (generated), `docs/output-schemas.md:232-234`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` (`--update-stale` for the removed `ci_gate`). Test rewrites (model imports become dict or advertised-schema reads): `tests/interfaces/facades/test_{mcp,library,internal_shim_removal_e54e_heldout,mcp_js_safe_integers,mcp_list_read_surface,bridge_programmatic_heldout,reconcile_cli_state_removal_82bb_heldout}.py`, `tests/interfaces/queries/test_{validate,next_batch}_compute.py`, `tests/unit/test_{attestation_signing,harness_provenance,claimed_session_read,opcert_producer_seam_8d8e,plan_review_health_surfaces,cross_session_mcp,mcp_writes,description_cap_warning,caused_by_link_validation,create_duplicate_warning,mcp_plan_review_status}.py`, fakes dropping `dump=`, plus `test_mcp_output_schema_coverage.py` (transition/reopen, write acks, `attach_commits`, `gate_status`, `verify_completion_status` move into CANONICAL; only `render_workflow` stays EXEMPT_GENERIC) and `test_mcp_http_transport.py` (drop the alias import and asserts, `:534-536,831-839`). Out of scope: signature derivation (next story), MCP-only tool bodies, CLI/library output.

## Testing
`tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_output_schema_canonical.py`: `test_every_advertised_output_schema_equals_its_canonical_file` (each table tool's advertised schema equals `inline_schema(names, kind)`); `test_output_schemas_are_self_contained`; `test_show_ticket_wire_payload_validates_with_absent_optionals` (in-memory session; validates; `last_reopened_at`/`source_id`/`cross_session_warning` absent; `assignee` null); `test_ready_tickets_full_and_lean_rows_validate` (lean rows validate against the closed `ready_ticket_summary`, full rows against `ticket_state`: one outputSchema cannot key on `full`, so the `anyOf` is as open as `ticket_state` and this test pins the lean contract); `test_write_ack_omits_unset_advisories` (no advisory keys; `push_status == {"state": "ok"}`); `test_set_file_impact_accepts_typed_entries` (a typed entry accepted; `reason: null` refused); `test_mcp_help_env_lines_unchanged`. Plus `gen_types --check`, `gen_mcp_reference.py --check`, `check_server_manifest.py`, `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `rebar._mcp_models` and `rebar.schemas.check_mcp_models` do not exist; `grep -rn "_mcp_models\|check_mcp_models" src tests scripts docs .github Makefile` returns only frozen fixture corpora (`tests/fixtures/`, `docs/experiments/`) and the two tests asserting the module is gone.
- [x] Every tool that advertises an `outputSchema` advertises the canonical file content (the diff test).
- [x] A `show_ticket` payload over the real session validates against `ticket_state.schema.json` with absent optionals, and no tool result carries a key whose value the library did not emit (the wire tests).
- [x] `list_tools()` count is 64 and exactly 11 tools lack an `outputSchema` (`test_mcp_output_schema_coverage.py` partition).
- [x] `MCP_ENV_VARS` entries have keys `{name, description}` only and `test_mcp_help_env_lines_unchanged` pins the `--help` env lines.
- [x] `check_server_manifest.py`, `gen_types --check`, `gen_mcp_reference.py --check`, `make verify` exit 0.
- [x] Non-codebase: `docs/release-notes.md` has the BREAKING entry stating the null-to-absent rule and naming the keys measured on the wire per tool family (reviewer-checked against the first comment's measurement).
